comparison_scope: Static input/output comparison against existing toolbox candidates and the authoritative route validator. No matched user task has measured triage time or compared this output with an existing workflow.
findings: The official route validator detects unmapped paths and selects validation targets; this candidate only groups caller-supplied unmapped_path rows by directory and normalized filename prefix.
The candidate does not identify canonical component owners, infer mapping patterns, change registries, or select validation targets.
The Actions-attribution, audit-finding, and job-timeline tools consume different input contracts and do not emit directory and filename-prefix cohorts for route residues.
Relative reviewer time, error reduction, and cost have not been measured; preserve uncertainty and run a low-cost same-task comparison before changing the candidate's lifecycle or route eligibility.
claim_ceiling: Structural grouping of caller-supplied path strings only. Cohorts do not imply shared component ownership, semantic equivalence, validation scope, or approval.
